result.summary: Found 1 visible issue: a prominent loading indicator appears over an already displayed restaurant card image, making the card look stuck or unfinished.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is visible in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image while the rest of the card content is already rendered. If this is not a temporary loading state, it looks visually broken or stuck.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image/card has loaded, or replace it with a proper skeleton/loading state until the image is fully ready.
